subpageUsage: Same LogoStrip component as the homepage, configured per page by props (no explicit `variant` prop). Subpage instances differ from the homepage in: the heading may be null (no line at all), may sit inside the centred component above the logos (`headingPlacement="inside"`) instead of above the container, the container may be small (45.25rem) instead of medium, and the row holds 5-8 neutral 'Logo' text placeholders instead of the six homepage logo files. At 1440 the logos sit in one row (space-between, gap 3rem, often wider than the container); at <=991 most pages wrap centred; at <=767 they wrap with justify-around. Used on the 17 /lms/features/* routes, /lms/solutions, /lms/small-business, /lms/demo-platform, /lms/spring-release, /lms/features, /nova, /mentoring, /company, /company/why-nimbus, /whats-included and /contact-us.
evidenceNotes: Every subpage passes placeholder objects {text: 'Logo', aspect}; only the homepage uses real logo files from /assets.
Longest heading: /company/why-nimbus 'Bringing learning, knowledge and people together for teams like these' (10 words); /lms/demo-platform's two-line heading is also 10 words.

pages-manifest.json agrees with the code for this component: every template it lists with logos->LogoStrip renders LogoStrip, and every LogoStrip usage is listed (feature-detail, /lms/solutions, /lms/small-business, /lms/spring-release, /lms/demo-platform, /lms/features, /nova, /mentoring, /company, /company/why-nimbus, /whats-included, /contact-us).
/company takes COMPANY_LOGOS from src/pages/company/shared.js (6 items); the other pages define local LOGOS arrays or inline arrays.
